hec.rss.model

Class DecisionSch

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.rss.model.DecisionSch
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, AltInputReportInfc, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable

    public class DecisionSch
extends java.lang.Object
implements AsciiSerializable, java.lang.Cloneable, AltInputReportInfc
    Decision Schedule for Reservoir Operation Sets. Each reservoir OpSet object will have one DecisionSch object that defines the frequency at which operating decisions are made.
    Version:
    1.0
    Author:
    John F. DeGeorge
    See Also:
